body: Build 0090. The deferred 1848 Paris measurement. Tyler anticipated the largest reading in the Paris file. A-1848 (Rue du Faubourg Saint-Antoine, July 1848): FAREWELL-B, 13ft. He was absent from his own departure — walked out of Paris without knowing where he was going, three days north without a destination. The mechanism measures what the subject was present for. He wasn't present. The most devastating departure is the smallest. Camera Op: 'You can only measure what you were present for.' Tyler: 'I was not present for my own departure.' Paris retrograde complete: 6 sites, 68ft total. Network maximum remains Lyon (47ft). More extra-archive sites becoming 'more thinkable.'
